title: API 安全
implementation: auth: strong-password one-shot initialize, PBKDF2 hashing, login lockout after repeated failures, single fixed session, session expiry and logout

audit: adminauth now writes AUTH_INITIALIZED / AUTH_LOGIN_FAILED / AUTH_LOGIN_LOCKED / AUTH_LOGIN_LOCKED_DENIED / AUTH_LOGIN_SUCCEEDED / AUTH_LOGGED_OUT rows into system_events inside the same transaction as the state change (90-day audit retention, no credential material in messages)
headers: API responses carry Cache-Control no-store and Pragma no-cache in addition to CSP, nosniff, X-Frame-Options DENY, and Referrer-Policy
webembed: traversal negative tests pin that path traversal attempts never return 200 or file content
